setup.title: Set up your system
setup.description: A short guide from an empty system to one that is ready to use, and a checklist that shows what is still missing. You can stop at any time, skip a step and come back later.
setup.company.label: Company
setup.company.help: Steps about a company are done once for each company.
setup.denied: You may not see the set-up guide.
setup.loadError: The set-up guide could not be loaded.
setup.steps.heading: Steps
setup.skip.note: Why are you skipping this step? (optional)
setup.toast.skipped: Step skipped. You can come back to it any time.
setup.decided: The system works this out from what you have entered. Make the change on its screen, then check again.
setup.manual: You tell us when this step is done.
setup.another.help: Add the company on the companies screen, then choose it above to go through the company steps again.
setup.import.offer: Already have this in a file? Import it instead of typing it in.
setup.modules.none: No modules are listed for your licence.
setup.modules.help: Switch a module on or off for a company on the feature flags screen. Only what your licence includes can be switched on.
setup.finished: All steps are done or skipped. Open the readiness checklist to see what is still missing before you go live.
setup.read.only: You can look at the set-up guide but not change it.
setup.steps.company_profile.body: Check the legal name, country, currency and language of the company and record its tax or registration number.
setup.steps.packs.body: Install the country pack of your companies (holidays, banks, lists and default settings) and any industry pack your licence includes.
setup.steps.languages_formats.body: Choose the language, time zone and number and date formats people will see, and the month the fiscal year starts.
setup.steps.modules.body: Choose which of the modules in your licence you will use.
setup.steps.structure.body: Add the first departments and units of the company, or import them.
setup.steps.users.body: Invite your first colleagues and give each one a role, or import them.
setup.steps.notifications.body: Review who is told about what and send yourself a test message. The sender and mail server are set up by the operator.
setup.steps.summary.body: Look over what is done, then open the readiness checklist.
setup.messages.company_fields_missing: The legal name, country, currency or language is missing.
setup.messages.registration_missing: No current tax or registration number is recorded.
setup.messages.location_missing: The company has no location yet.
setup.messages.units_missing: The company has no organization units yet.
setup.messages.holidays_missing: No holiday calendar with holidays in {year} is linked to the company or its locations.
setup.messages.no_pack: No country or industry pack is installed yet.
setup.messages.numbering_missing: {count} document types have no numbering scheme: {types}
setup.messages.routes_missing: {count} document types have no active approval route: {types}
setup.messages.other_administrator_missi: Only one person can administer the system. Add a second administrator so nobody is locked out.
setup.messages.check_missing: This item cannot be checked yet.
setup.messages.check_failed: The check could not run. Try again in a moment.
setup.checklist.empty.body: The modules you have installed list no readiness items.
setup.checklist.company.needed: Choose a company to see its checklist.
setup.checklist.liveOverride: Went live with required items open. Reason: {reason}
setup.goLive.title: Take {name} live
setup.goLive.ready: Every required item is done. Taking the module live is recorded with your name and the time.
setup.goLive.open: {count} required items are still open. You can go live anyway, but you must give a reason. The reason is kept in the audit log.
setup.goLive.reason: Reason for going live with open items
setup.goLive.done: {name} is now live for this company.
setup.error.generic: That did not work. Try again.
setup.error.network: The server could not be reached. Try again.
